select f.id as id, f.module_id as moduleId, t.table_id as tableId, f.column_id as fieldId, f.module_table_id as moduleTableId, ctd.table_name as tableName, coalesce(m.column_name,f.column_name) as fieldName, coalesce(m.column_comment,f.column_comment) as fieldComment, f.column_alias_name as fieldAliasName, f.sys_alias_name as sysAliasName, coalesce(m.column_name,f.column_name) as fieldValue, m.is_not_null as required, m.java_type as dataType, m.jdbc_type as jdbcType, m.is_sys isSys, f.mapping_field_id as mappingFieldId, f.compute_sql as computeSql, m.is_primary_key isPk
,mm.column_name as mappingFieldName ,mf.module_table_id as mappingMouduleTableId , f.value_type as valueType, f.text_sql as textSql from cfg_module_field f left join cfg_module_table t on f.module_table_id = t.id left join cfg_column_definition m on m.table_id = t.table_id and m.id = f.column_id left join cfg_table_definition ctd on t.table_id = ctd.id
left join (select * from cfg_module_field where module_id=#{mappingModuleId}) mf on f.id=mf.mapping_field_id left join cfg_module_table mt on mf.module_table_id = mt.id left join cfg_column_definition mm on mm.table_id = mt.table_id and mm.id = mf.column_id
f.module_id = #{moduleId}

SELECT f.id, f.module_id, f.module_table_id, f.column_id, f.column_id as fieldId, coalesce(m.column_type,f.column_type) as columnType, coalesce(m.column_name,f.column_name) as columnName, coalesce(m.column_comment,f.column_comment) as columnComment, coalesce(m.column_length,f.column_length) as columnLength, coalesce(m.default_value,f.default_value) as defaultValue, f.column_alias_name, f.compute_sql, f.remark, m.is_not_null as required, m.is_sys isSys, f.mapping_field_id, m.is_primary_key as isPrimaryKey, m.java_type as javaType, m.jdbc_type as jdbcType, f.text_table_id as textTableId, f.text_column_id as textColumnId, f.text_table_key as textTableKey, f.text_sql as text_sql, f.value_Type as valueType, m.sort, f.is_back_data as isBackData from cfg_module_field f left join cfg_module_table t on f.module_table_id = t.id left join cfg_column_definition m on m.table_id = t.table_id and m.id = f.column_id where f.module_id = #{moduleId} AND f.DELETED = 0 union all select null as id, t.module_id, t.id as moduleTableId, c.id as columnId, c.id as fieldId, c.column_type as columnType, c.column_name as columnName, c.column_comment as columnComment, c.column_length as columnLength, c.default_value as defaultValue, c.column_name as columnAliasName, null as computeSql, null as remark, c.is_not_null as required, c.is_sys isSys, null as mapping_field_id, c.is_primary_key as isPrimaryKey, c.java_type as javaType, c.jdbc_type as jdbcType, null as textTableId, null as textColumnId, null as textTableKey, null as text_sql, null as valueType, c.sort, null as isBackData from cfg_column_definition c inner join cfg_module_table t on c.table_id = t.table_id where c.id not in ( SELECT f.column_id from cfg_module_field f where f.module_id = #{moduleId} ) and t.module_id=#{moduleId} and c.status=1

select f.table_name tableName, e.table_alias tableAlias, b.column_name columnName, a.sys_alias_name sysAliasName, c.table_name textTable, d.column_name textColumn, g.column_name textTableKey from cfg_module_field a inner join cfg_column_definition b on a.column_id = b.id and b.deleted ='0' inner join cfg_table_definition c on a.text_table_id = c.id and c.deleted ='0' inner join cfg_column_definition d on a.text_column_id = d.id and d.deleted ='0' inner join cfg_column_definition g on a.text_table_key = g.id and g.deleted ='0' inner join cfg_module_table e on a.module_table_id = e.id and e.deleted ='0' inner join cfg_table_definition f on e.table_id = f.id and f.deleted ='0' where a.module_id=#{moduleId} and a.deleted ='0' and a.module_table_id in #{it,jdbcType=BIGINT}
